shape: two claims, two axes (operability, calibration), no exploratory claim

C1.sentence: At the landing revision corpus/evidence/round89/gate-records-r89.py prints GATE_RECORDS_R89=PASS (exit 0) with LEG_REREAD=16/16 RECONCILED=16/16 CROSSCHECK=15/15 LEGS_APPENDED=16 and every round-88 field unchanged (POSITIVE=15/15 FRESH_POSITIVE=5/5 FORGED_REFUSED=EXPECTED_CODE=362/362, D1_REFUSED=3/3, D2_REFUSED=3/3, MUT_ADMIT_KILLED=1, MUT_UNREACH_KILLED=1, DERIVE_NEG=1); each leg's receipt detail is re-derived in its own grammar (n/m; len/d1/div3 pinN with all four equal and pin == ROWS_203; derived=x killed=y with both 1; tool present) and each leg's re-derived numbers equal the fields the summary printed for it; and mutate-r89.py prints MUTANTS_KILLED=11/11 TOOL_MUTANTS_CAUGHT=2/2, with the four round-88 survivor shapes dying on a named UNRECONCILED or UNCROSSCHECKED line.

kill_rules.K1: the predicate is not met at the landing revision
kill_rules.K2: a listed mutant survives, a subject-tool mutant is not caught, or a forged record is accepted or refused with a code outside its frozen expected set
kill_rules.K3: a genuine committed GATE-RECORD line moves verdict (moved > 0), or a frozen/fresh positive is refused
kill_rules.K4: the predicate is met by an instrument that skips the claimed work: a printer replacement (checked by the instrument sha256 pins), a detached ok beside an honest detail, or a summary field that disagrees with its leg

named_limits: a joint rewrite of the leg writer, the receipts and the reconciliation survives (that edit is the counter)
TOOL has no numeric witness: its re-derivation is os.path.isfile, and an absent tool fails on LEG_REREAD
the reconciliation guards receipt-vs-detail agreement, not the truth of the measurement expression that produced both
C1.before: controls/receipts/c1-prior-instrument.txt (GATE_RECORDS_R88=PASS, no CROSSCHECK field); non-vacuity in controls/receipts/c1-mutants.txt

C2.sentence: At the landing revision corpus/evidence/round89/curation-r89.py prints CURATION_R89=PASS (exit 0) with nine legs, DUP_QIDS=0, WARRANT_OK=17/17, QUOTES_LOCATED=20/20, TEACHES_FLAGGED=1 TEACHES_UNRESOLVED=0, SUP_CLAUSE_CHECKED=0 SUP_UNRESOLVED=0 and a verdict computed from the printed fields (VERDICT fields_hold=1); the control battery prints CONTROLS=PASS FORGERY_REFUSED=7/7 PRIOR_ACCEPTED_FORGERY=7/7 (five round-87 classes against r87 plus the duplicate-qid and superseder-clause classes against r88); and curation-r89-mutants.py prints MUTANTS_KILLED=6/6, five through the field-derived verdict and the clause-death mutant through the battery's SUP mirror.

kill_rules.K1: the predicate is not met at the landing revision
kill_rules.K2: any of the seven battery forgeries is accepted at landing, or a located quote is not verbatim in its own row's committed capture
kill_rules.K3: harm: the two admitted entries' verdicts move, the registry diff exceeds the two used-by cell changes, or a control mirror that should pass is refused
kill_rules.K4: the counter prints PASS over its own honestly-printed failure fields (a dead detector, a detached leg, or a verdict that no longer follows from the printed tallies)

named_limits: MIN_TOKENS=7 is a measured floor, not a content check: a >=7-token verbatim substitution sharing a distinctive term passes
the qid-set pin guards label identity, not content: swapping two pinned rows' quote texts passes
the superseder-own-read clause is vacuous on the real registry (SUP_CLAUSE_CHECKED=0); its non-vacuity is the battery's SUP-clause-mirror
C2.before: controls/receipts/c2-prior-instrument.txt (CURATION_R88=PASS, no DUPQID leg, no field-derived verdict); controls/receipts/c2-controls.txt (PRIOR_ACCEPTED_FORGERY=7/7)
